title: Keep One Secret and You GLOW 💡
description:
I kept one secret, and now I glow. In this town, everybody can see it, and the planner lights up the whole street. Most people have a faint rim of light around them. I'd never had any, until now. I tell my grandpa everything.

Grandpa Abe guides at the museum on Friday late openings, and he's always been the brightest man in town. This spring he got brighter every week, until people crossed the road when he passed and the museum moved him to the dark galleries. Then I noticed a line wiped clean through the dust on every case, at knee height.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment GLOW if you'd light up the whole street right now.
